title: Comparison of a Proj twist with any prescribed glued twist
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x₀,x₁] with its standard grading, d an integer, and C a chart-compatible isomorphism Proj S ≅ P¹_k [def-sc-p1-proj-chart-isomorphism]. Let L be an O-module on P¹_k with specified TwistData of degree d [def-sc-p1-standard]. Then Proj.twist S d [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] is isomorphic to tensorPullback(C.iso.hom)(L) [def-pc-module-pullback]. No choice or existence of C or L is asserted.

source.place: Definition 27.10.1 (1), Lemma 01M7 (2),(3); parent node chart and overlap proof steps

proof.text: Set M=O_Proj(d), N=(C.iso.inv)^*M using ordinary source-library pullback. Apply lem-sc-p1-proj-twist-transported-data to equip N with TwistData of degree d.

Apply exists_twistData_unique_iso from lem-sc-p1-twist-exists to get a reference twist L₀. Its uniqueness clause gives eN:L₀≅N and eL:L₀≅L, so eN.symm ≪≫ eL:N≅L. This is exactly the generator-preserving local gluing part of the original route, now supplied by the existing theorem.

The tensor pullback and ordinary pullback along C.iso.inv are left adjoints of the same module pushforward. Apply Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq to their adjunctions and evaluate at M. Compose this comparison with eN.symm and eL to obtain tensorPullback(C.iso.inv)(M)≅L.

Apply nonempty_tensorPullbackComp to C.iso.hom followed by C.iso.inv. Since their composite is the identity of Proj, nonempty_tensorPullbackId gives tensorPullback(C.iso.hom)(tensorPullback(C.iso.inv)(M))≅M. Invert it and compose with the image of the previous isomorphism under tensorPullback(C.iso.hom). The resulting isomorphism is exactly M≅tensorPullback(C.iso.hom)(L).

proof_origin.place: Chart/transition argument followed by the existing blueprint twist uniqueness theorem and formal pullback identities; Lean proof by H3

theorem nonempty_twist_iso_tensorPullback_of_twistData (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (d : ℤ) (C : ProjectiveLine.ProjChartIsomorphism k)
    (L : (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).Modules)
    (T : ProjectiveLine.TwistData (Spec (.of k)) d L) :
    Nonempty (twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) d ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback C.iso.hom).obj L)
